result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, so your example gives Anna 2 and Bob 1.

- **Fix:** `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (around line 6517). I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the purchase order subquery, the same filter the quarter and latest-PO queries already use.
- **Test:** `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`. I added `leavesOutCancelledPurchaseOrders`, which reproduces your example and expects `Anna:2`, `Bob:1`. I also gave the `purchaseOrder` helper an overload that takes a status.

`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (4 tests). I did not run the test against the unfixed code, but without the filter the new test would report Bob:3. Nothing is committed.
